novelty_flags.label: Theorem: finite-fiber shell certificate
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed improvement is only an entropy-free upper bound on a deliberately randomized finite subexperiment whose nuisance is annihilated by a known pseudo-outcome, not a rate/constant improvement or first bound on a published CATE model; tier=letter below novelty_target=field.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem: finite-fiber shell certificate
novelty_flags.one_line: Its consumer, “Finite privacy audits can enlarge the baseline wavelet codebook,” names neither a paper nor a concrete applied domain or open problem that requires this finite-fiber result.

soundness_flags.label: lem:bernoulli-preservation / thm:bernoulli-minimax-equivalence
soundness_flags.one_line: K_B is defined only as an observed-record kernel, so K_B P is not a defined full causal law in M_pm; specify a full-data kernel/lift producing binary potential outcomes and prove its exchangeability and consistency preservation.

soundness_flags.label: ass:uniform-design and the finite-fiber headline
soundness_flags.one_line: Exact uniform covariate design is an instrumental strengthening used to make the public local average unbiased and its justification only says it is the destination model; justify a real design setting or extend the certificate to a standard bounded-density/known-density class.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 13 is an epsilon-DP T-mechanism guarantee for a discrete family with log(|P|/beta)/n dependence; Proposition 16 applies it to a finite TV cover and retains log(|P_eta|/beta)/n dependence.

Theorem 3.4 gives a pointwise risk upper bound for their distributed (epsilon,delta)-DP nonparametric-regression protocol, and Theorem 4.4 gives a matching pointwise minimax lower bound up to logarithmic factors.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace exact-uniform design by a standard bounded-away-from-zero covariate density (or explicitly restrict to a real randomized-design application) and derive the corresponding weighted one-sensitive score.

Promote the shell mechanism to a published observational CATE class with unknown propensity, or prove a strict same-model rate/constant improvement over a named CATE-private comparator rather than over a generic finite-cover guarantee.
Define a full-data Bernoullization kernel for (Y0,Y1,A,X), then state the DP preprocessing and minimax-risk transfer formally from that kernel.
Add a focused central-DP nonparametric-regression survey, including Golowich (2021), and explain why its private learning mechanisms do not subsume the proposed pointwise finite-fiber claim.

recommended_next_step: Revise around a practical published CATE model and a genuine statistical-frontier comparison; repair the full-data Bernoullization reduction before advancing to Stage 0.
